id="content-head"><h1 class="Title Title1">API Onboarding and Authentication</h1></div></div></header><div class="rm-Markdown markdown-body content-body" data-testid="RDMD"><p>Welcome to the <a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/docs/insights-api">Insights API</a>! With our powerful API, you can take advantage of advanced AI-driven recommendations and insights. This guide will help you get up and running quickly by walking you through authentication, making your first API call, and exploring key features.</p>
<h1 class="heading heading-1 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="accessing-the-api"></div><div class="heading-text">Accessing the API</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Accessing the API" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#accessing-the-api"></a></h1>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="get-an-api-key"></div><div class="heading-text">Get an API Key</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Get an API Key" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#get-an-api-key"></a></h2>
<p>To get started, you'll need an API key. Simply <a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/support@qloo.com">contact us</a>, and we'll generate one for you.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="authentication"></div><div class="heading-text">Authentication</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Authentication" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#authentication"></a></h2>
<p>Once you have your API key, authenticate your requests by including it in the request headers.</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="curl">cURL</button><button type="button" value="javascript">JavaScript</button><button type="button" value="python">Python</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-curl theme-light" data-lang="curl"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--location</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET <span class="cm-string">'https://staging.api.qloo.com/v2/insights?query=audi'</span> \
<span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'Content-Type: application/json'</span> \
<span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: &lt;your-api-key&gt;'</span></div></code></pre><pre><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-javascript theme-light" data-lang="javascript"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-keyword">const</span> <span class="cm-def">fetch</span> <span class="cm-operator">=</span> <span class="cm-variable">require</span>(<span class="cm-string">'node-fetch'</span>);

<span class="cm-keyword">const</span> <span class="cm-def">config</span> <span class="cm-operator">=</span> {
  <span class="cm-property">headers</span>: {
    <span class="cm-string cm-property">'Content-Type'</span>: <span class="cm-string">'application/json'</span>,
    <span class="cm-string cm-property">'X-Api-Key'</span>: <span class="cm-variable">process</span>.<span class="cm-property">env</span>.<span class="cm-property">API_KEY</span>,
  },
};

<span class="cm-variable">fetch</span>(<span class="cm-string">'https://staging.api.qloo.com/v2/insights?query=audi'</span>, <span class="cm-variable">config</span>).<span class="cm-property">then</span>(<span class="cm-def">r</span> <span class="cm-operator">=&gt;</span> <span class="cm-variable-2">r</span>.<span class="cm-property">json</span>()).<span class="cm-property">then</span>(<span class="cm-variable">console</span>.<span class="cm-property">log</span>);</div></code></pre><pre><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-python theme-light" data-lang="python"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-keyword">import</span> <span class="cm-variable">os</span>
<span class="cm-keyword">import</span> <span class="cm-variable">requests</span>

<span class="cm-variable">url</span> <span class="cm-operator">=</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://staging.api.qloo.com/v2/insights?query=audi'</span>
<span class="cm-variable">headers</span> <span class="cm-operator">=</span> {<span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key'</span>: <span class="cm-variable">os</span>.<span class="cm-property">environ</span>[<span class="cm-string">'API_KEY'</span>]}
<span class="cm-variable">r</span> <span class="cm-operator">=</span> <span class="cm-variable">requests</span>.<span class="cm-property">get</span>(<span class="cm-variable">url</span>, <span class="cm-variable">headers</span><span class="cm-operator">=</span><span class="cm-variable">headers</span>)
<span class="cm-builtin">print</span>(<span class="cm-variable">r</span>.<span class="cm-property">json</span>())</div></code></pre></div></div>
<h1 class="heading heading-1 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="making-your-first-api-call"></div><div class="heading-text">Making Your First API Call</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Making Your First API Call" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#making-your-first-api-call"></a></h1>
<p>Now that you're set up, you can make your first request. Here’s a request example that returns a list of movies tagged as comedies. It includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>The API request URL</li>
<li>An entity type filter indicating the results should only include movies</li>
<li>A filter narrowing results to entities tagged with "comedy"</li>
<li>Your API key for authentication</li>
</ul>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="curl">Basic Insights Request Example</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-curl theme-light" data-lang="curl"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--location</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://staging.api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:entity:movie&amp;filter.tags=urn:tag:genre:media:comedy'</span> \
<span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'x-api-key: x-api-key'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p>To dig deeper into a basic Insights request, explore our basic request <a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/basic-insights-use-case">use case</a>.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="handling-responses"></div><div class="heading-text">Handling Responses</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Handling Responses" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#handling-responses"></a></h2>

<h1 class="heading heading-1 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="key-features-of-the-api"></div><div class="heading-text">Key Features of the API</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Key Features of the API" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#key-features-of-the-api"></a></h1>
<ul>
<li><strong>Flexible Input and Output</strong>: Seamlessly processes a wide range of data types—entities, tags, demographics, audiences, and location—allowing you to input and receive highly relevant results across the same categories.</li>
<li><strong>Extensive Filtering and Customization</strong>: With a broad range of filters and signal parameters, you can fine-tune your queries to ensure the results are precisely tailored to your needs. Whether you're focusing on specific genres, demographics, or locations, the Insights API offers the flexibility you need.</li>
<li><strong>Versatile Applications</strong>: Suitable for live personalization, CRM optimization, product development, media buying, and more.</li>
</ul>
<h1 class="heading heading-1 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="common-use-cases"></div><div class="heading-text">Common Use Cases</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Common Use Cases" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#common-use-cases"></a></h1>
<p>The Insights API is versatile and can be applied across a wide range of <a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/use-cases">use cases</a>. It gives you the tools to unlock powerful insights into user preferences and behaviors.</p></div><div class="Footer-desktop1Hf-2fUBeoe2"><div align="center" class="Flex Flex_row " justify="between" <hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="1-deprecated-audience-endpoints"></div><div class="heading-text">1. Deprecated Audience Endpoints</div><a aria-label="Skip link to 1. Deprecated Audience Endpoints" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#1-deprecated-audience-endpoints"></a></h2>
<p>The <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/recommendations</span></code> and <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/recs</span></code> endpoints are the <strong>legacy/deprecated endpoints</strong> you should avoid. According to the Hackathon Developer Guide<sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/qloo-llm-hackathon-developer-guide">1</a></sup>, these are not supported and will not work.</p>
<p><strong>The alternative</strong> is to use <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/insights</span></code>, which is the primary, fully supported endpoint for recommendations and insights. For audience-related signals, you can still pass audience values via <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">signal.demographics.audiences</span></code> in your Insights requests.</p>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="2-hackathon-api-key-access"></div><div class="heading-text">2. Hackathon API Key Access</div><a aria-label="Skip link to 2. Hackathon API Key Access" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#2-hackathon-api-key-access"></a></h2>
<p>Hackathon API keys give access to <strong>all documented Qloo endpoints</strong>, but with one important caveat — they <strong>only work against the hackathon base URL</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">https://hackathon.api.qloo.com</span></code></pre>
<p>They will <strong>not</strong> work against:</p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">https://staging.api.qloo.com</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">https://api.qloo.com</span></code></li>
</ul>
<p>Using the wrong base URL is the most common cause of <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">401 Unauthorized</span></code> errors. Additionally, some entity types may return a <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">403</span></code> if they are not supported in the hackathon environment. See the full list of supported entity types<sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/qloo-llm-hackathon-developer-guide">1</a></sup> in the guide.</p></div></div><div class="AssistantMessageParts-sourceFooter1V0q6O5xuLXI"><button aria-controls="Collapsible-group-rh" aria-expanded="true" tabindex="0" type="button" align="center" class="Flex Flex_row Collapsible-summary2wqJT_PZzn05 Collapsible-summary_opened13VM6gUqQFUr AssistantMessageParts-sourceToggle33LUyyTfyXL8" justify="start" style="--flex-gap: var(--xs);"><span class="IconWrapper Icon-wrapper2z2wVIeGsiUy"><svg fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="Icon Icon3_D2ysxFZ_ll Icon-svg2Lm7f6G9Ly5a Collapsible-summary-icon1HJWq_Rg_gkI AssistantMessageParts-sourceChevron3ndOQpSlYwGN" data-name="chevron-right" role="img" style="--icon-color: inherit; --icon-size: inherit; --icon-stroke-width: 2px;"><path stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" class="icon-stroke-width"></path></svg></span><span class="AssistantMessageParts-sourceSummary1Pd6DW79saNq">1 source</span></button><div aria-hidden="false" class="Collapsible1qpVZ2UrdZI- Collapsible_opened" id="Collapsible-group-rh" role="group" style="height: 32px;"><ol class="AssistantMessageParts-sourceList2s1yWvFY1PCP Collapsible-content1FP-sbp7hOaa Collapsible-content_openedO-LHWjFH_-Iz"><li><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/qloo-llm-hackathon-developer-guide" class="AssistantMessageParts-sourceLink3kJphVpBsHHp"><span class="IconWrapper Icon-wrapper2z2wVIeGsiUy"><svg fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" class="Icon Icon3_D2ysxFZ_ll Icon-svg2Lm7f6G9Ly5a AssistantMessageParts-sourceIcon1gC59Zh4j6ln" data-name="file-text" role="img" aria-hidden="true" style="--icon-color: inherit; --icon-size: var(--icon-md); --icon-stroke-width: 2px;"><path stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8l-6-6Z" class="icon-stroke-width"></path><path stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M14 2v6h6M16 13H8M16 17H8M10 9H8" class="icon-stroke-width"></path></svg></span><span class="AssistantMessageParts-sourceTitle3RBFa36Wt9Xi">Qloo Agentic Hackathon Developer Guide</span></a></li></ol></div></div><div class="voteButtonsH0cpah4yjCZi"><button aria-label="Helpful" aria-pressed="false" class="voteButton2OzVRflzG3-f" type="button"><i aria-hidden="true" class="icon-thumbs-up-2"></i></button><button aria-label="Not helpful" aria-pressed="false" class="voteButton2OzVRflzG3-f" type="button"><i aria-hidden="true" class="icon-thumbs-down1"></i></button></div></div></div></div><div class="message1-avf6LpG_IQ rm-AskAi-message"><div class="content3zn989b3tvo9"><div class="userMessage2P2RqFJ8eO-3">I’m building an AI marketing audience-discovery workflow using Qloo.

Use case: A business has a new product and wants to discover who to advertise to, where they are, what demographics/interest groups to target, and what messaging may resonate with each audience.

I want to understand the correct Qloo API workflow:

1. Product/business inputs: What information should I extract from the product, brand, or business (e.g. category, brand, product attributes, target market, existing customers) and how should I represent these as Qloo entities, search queries, or signals?
2. Search: Which Qloo Search endpoints/types should I use to identify the relevant product/brand and related entities?
3. Insights/signals: Which signals should I provide to "/v2/insights" to discover relevant audiences and affinities?
4. Filters: How should I configure filters when I want:
   - audience interests/affinities,
   - demographics,
   - geographic/heat-map information,
   - combinations of demographics + geography + interests?
5. Response processing: Which fields from Qloo responses are most useful for an LLM to analyze?
6. AI synthesis: How should I structure the Qloo results so an LLM can produce recommendations such as:
   - “Target this audience in this location with this message”
   - “Target this demographic with this positioning”
   - “This is an unexpected audience segment worth testing”
   - “These audiences have the strongest evidence/affinity.”

Please give me a concrete end-to-end API workflow, including example requests, the signals/filters used at each stage, and the important response fields to retain. Focus specifically on Qloo’s current API capabilities for marketing audience discovery, rather than a generic marketing workflow.</div></div></div><div class="message1-Y4wUKVloKC rm-AskAi-message"><div class="content23-qR8_3wg3-"><div class="assistantMessage32OB6of0RRq6"><div class="AssistantMessageParts-textPart2TIqe2N4lynz"><div class="rm-Markdown markdown-body AssistantMessageParts-markdownContent37Udj2xJaw-J" data-testid="RDMD"><p>Let me pull together the relevant documentation across search, insights, parameters, audiences, demographics, heatmaps, and tags.</p></div></div><div class="AssistantMessageParts-textPart2TIqe2N4lynz"><div class="rm-Markdown markdown-body AssistantMessageParts-markdownContent37Udj2xJaw-J" data-testid="RDMD"><p>Here is a complete end-to-end Qloo API workflow for AI-driven marketing audience discovery.</p>
<hr>
<h1 class="heading heading-1 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="qloo-marketing-audience-discovery-end-to-end-workflow"></div><div class="heading-text">Qloo Marketing Audience Discovery: End-to-End Workflow</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Qloo Marketing Audience Discovery: End-to-End Workflow" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#qloo-marketing-audience-discovery-end-to-end-workflow"></a></h1>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="overview-of-the-pipeline"></div><div class="heading-text">Overview of the Pipeline</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Overview of the Pipeline" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#overview-of-the-pipeline"></a></h2>
<pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">Product/Brand Input
      ↓
[Step 1] Search → Resolve brand/entity IDs + discover relevant tags
      ↓
[Step 2] Taste Analysis → Psychographic profile of the brand's audience
      ↓
[Step 3] Audience Discovery → Find audience segments that over-index
      ↓
[Step 4] Cross-Domain Affinity → What else does this audience love?
      ↓
[Step 5] Demographic Breakdown → Age &amp; gender distribution per segment
      ↓
[Step 6] Geographic Heatmap → Where are these audiences concentrated?
      ↓
[Step 7] Audience Comparison → Rank segments by evidence strength
      ↓
[Step 8] LLM Synthesis → Generate targeting &amp; messaging recommendations</span></code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-1-extract-inputs--resolve-entity-ids"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 1: Extract Inputs &amp; Resolve Entity IDs</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 1: Extract Inputs &amp; Resolve Entity IDs" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-1-extract-inputs--resolve-entity-ids"></a></h2>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="what-to-extract-from-the-productbusiness"></div><div class="heading-text">What to extract from the product/business</div><a aria-label="Skip link to What to extract from the product/business" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#what-to-extract-from-the-productbusiness"></a></h3>








































<div class="rdmd-table"><div class="rdmd-table-inner"><table><thead><tr><th>Input type</th><th>What to capture</th><th>Qloo representation</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Brand name</td><td>"Nike", "Glossier"</td><td>Search → <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:entity:brand</span></code></td></tr><tr><td>Product category</td><td>"athletic footwear", "skincare"</td><td>Search tags via <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/tags</span></code></td></tr><tr><td>Competitor brands</td><td>"Adidas", "Fenty Beauty"</td><td>Search → <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:entity:brand</span></code> (use as comparative signal)</td></tr><tr><td>Existing customer interests</td><td>genres, artists, shows they love</td><td>Search → entity IDs for any type</td></tr><tr><td>Target market</td><td>"women 25–34", "urban millennials"</td><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">signal.demographics.age</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">signal.demographics.gender</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">signal.demographics.audiences</span></code></td></tr><tr><td>Geography</td><td>"NYC", "West Coast"</td><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">filter.location.query</span></code> or WKT polygon</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="search-for-the-brand-entity-id"></div><div class="heading-text">Search for the brand entity ID</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Search for the brand entity ID" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#search-for-the-brand-entity-id"></a></h3>
<p>Use <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/search</span></code><sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/get-search">1</a></sup> to resolve the brand name to a Qloo UUID:</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/search?query=Nike&amp;types=urn:entity:brand&amp;take=5'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p><strong>Key response fields to retain:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">entity_id</span></code> — the UUID you'll use in all downstream calls</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">name</span></code> — confirm you matched the right entity</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">subtype</span></code> — confirms entity type (e.g., <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:entity:brand</span></code>)</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">tags[]</span></code> — the brand's existing genre/category tags (e.g., <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:tag:genre:brand:fashion:footwear</span></code>)</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">popularity</span></code> — baseline signal strength</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="search-for-relevant-tags"></div><div class="heading-text">Search for relevant tags</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Search for relevant tags" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#search-for-relevant-tags"></a></h3>
<p>Use <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/tags</span></code><sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/get-tags-1">2</a></sup> to find tag URNs representing the product's category:</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/tags?filter.query=athletic+footwear&amp;take=10'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p><strong>Retain:</strong> <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">id</span></code> (the URN like <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:tag:genre:brand:fashion:footwear:sneakers</span></code>) — use in signal and filter parameters downstream.</p>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-2-taste-analysis--psychographic-profile"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 2: Taste Analysis — Psychographic Profile</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 2: Taste Analysis — Psychographic Profile" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-2-taste-analysis--psychographic-profile"></a></h2>
<p>Use Taste Analysis<sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/taste-analysis">3</a></sup> to discover the psychographic tags that define the brand's audience. This is <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">filter.type=urn:tag</span></code>, which reverses the usual flow — instead of returning entities, it returns the taste vocabulary of the audience.</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-comment"># Get lifestyle/ambience tags associated with the brand's audience</span>
<span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:tag&amp;signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID&amp;take=20'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p>You can scope to a specific tag namespace with <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">filter.tag.types</span></code> (e.g., lifestyle, ambience, genre):</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:tag&amp;filter.tag.types=urn:tag:keyword:brand&amp;signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID&amp;take=20'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p><strong>Key response fields to retain from <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">results.tags[]</span></code>:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">tag_id</span></code> — use in downstream signals</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">name</span></code> — human-readable label (e.g., "Streetwear", "Sustainability")</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.affinity</span></code> — how strongly the tag defines this audience (0–1); higher = stronger psychographic signal</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>LLM use:</strong> Feed top tags to the LLM as the brand's psychographic fingerprint. These become the basis for messaging themes.</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-3-audience-segment-discovery"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 3: Audience Segment Discovery</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 3: Audience Segment Discovery" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-3-audience-segment-discovery"></a></h2>
<p>Find which Qloo audience segments over-index for this brand. First, look up valid audience URNs via <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/audiences</span></code><sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/get-audiences-1">4</a></sup>:</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-comment"># Discover audiences related to the brand's space</span>
<span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/audiences?filter.query=sneakers&amp;take=10'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p><strong>Retain from <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">results.audiences[]</span></code>:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">id</span></code> — the URN (e.g., <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:hobbies_and_interests:outdoors</span></code>) — pass this to <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">signal.demographics.audiences</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">name</span></code> — human-readable label</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">type</span></code> — parent category (e.g., <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:spending_habits</span></code>)</li>
</ul>
<p>You can also list all audience categories via <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/audience-types</span></code><sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/get-audience-types-1">5</a></sup> to survey the full taxonomy:</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/audience-types'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p>Valid audience parent categories include:</p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:hobbies_and_interests</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:spending_habits</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:lifestyle_preferences_beliefs</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:life_stage</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:communities</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:professional_area</span></code></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-4-cross-domain-affinity--what-does-this-audience-love"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 4: Cross-Domain Affinity — What Does This Audience Love?</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 4: Cross-Domain Affinity — What Does This Audience Love?" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-4-cross-domain-affinity--what-does-this-audience-love"></a></h2>
<p>Use the brand entity as a signal and ask for correlated entities in other domains. This reveals adjacent interests that inform both media planning and messaging.</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-comment"># What movies does this brand's audience love?</span>
<span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:entity:movie&amp;signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID&amp;take=15'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span>

<span class="cm-comment"># What artists do they listen to?</span>
<span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:entity:artist&amp;signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID&amp;take=15'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span>

<span class="cm-comment"># What other brands are they affine to? (useful for partnership/co-marketing)</span>
<span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:entity:brand&amp;signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID&amp;take=15'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p><strong>Key response fields to retain from <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">results.entities[]</span></code>:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">entity_id</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">name</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">subtype</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.affinity</span></code> — correlation strength (0–1)</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.popularity</span></code> — entity's baseline signal density</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">tags[]</span></code> — entity's own genre/attribute tags (useful for messaging context)</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>LLM use:</strong> Cross-domain affinity tells the LLM <em>what cultural world</em> this audience inhabits — essential for media channel selection and creative messaging.</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-5-demographic-breakdown"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 5: Demographic Breakdown</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 5: Demographic Breakdown" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-5-demographic-breakdown"></a></h2>
<p>Use <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">filter.type=urn:demographics</span></code><sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/demographics-use-case">6</a></sup> to get the age and gender distribution for the brand's audience, and compare it to category-level tags:</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:demographics&amp;signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID&amp;signal.interests.tags=urn:tag:genre:brand:fashion:footwear'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p><strong>Key response fields to retain from <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">results.demographics[]</span></code>:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">entity_id</span></code> — which signal this demographic block is for</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.age.*</span></code> — affinity score per age bucket (positive = over-indexes, negative = under-indexes)
<ul>
<li>Buckets: <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">24_and_younger</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">25_to_29</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">30_to_34</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">35_to_44</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">45_to_54</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">55_and_older</span></code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.gender.male</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.gender.female</span></code> — gender skew</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>LLM use:</strong> The LLM can compare the brand's demographic profile vs. the category average (by running both as signals) to identify where the brand over- or under-indexes relative to its competitive set. A positive age value like <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">30_to_34: 0.70</span></code> means strong over-indexing in that cohort.</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="running-demographics-filtered-by-a-specific-audience-segment"></div><div class="heading-text">Running demographics filtered by a specific audience segment</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Running demographics filtered by a specific audience segment" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#running-demographics-filtered-by-a-specific-audience-segment"></a></h3>
<p>Once you know your target audience URN (Step 3), you can layer it in:</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:demographics&amp;signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID&amp;signal.demographics.audiences=urn:audience:hobbies_and_interests:fitness'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-6-geographic-heatmap--where-are-these-audiences"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 6: Geographic Heatmap — Where Are These Audiences?</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 6: Geographic Heatmap — Where Are These Audiences?" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-6-geographic-heatmap--where-are-these-audiences"></a></h2>
<p>Use <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">filter.type=urn:heatmap</span></code><sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/heatmaps-use-case">7</a></sup> to identify geographic concentration of affinity for the brand. You can use a natural-language location query or a precise WKT polygon.</p>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="by-city-name"></div><div class="heading-text">By city name</div><a aria-label="Skip link to By city name" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#by-city-name"></a></h3>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:heatmap&amp;filter.location.query=Los+Angeles&amp;signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="by-precise-geographic-boundary-wkt-polygon"></div><div class="heading-text">By precise geographic boundary (WKT polygon)</div><a aria-label="Skip link to By precise geographic boundary (WKT polygon)" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#by-precise-geographic-boundary-wkt-polygon"></a></h3>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:heatmap&amp;filter.location=POLYGON((-74.0479+40.6829,-74.0479+40.7831,-73.9067+40.7831,-73.9067+40.6829,-74.0479+40.6829))&amp;signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="heatmap-with-demographic-layering"></div><div class="heading-text">Heatmap with demographic layering</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Heatmap with demographic layering" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#heatmap-with-demographic-layering"></a></h3>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/insights/?filter.type=urn:heatmap&amp;filter.location.query=NYC&amp;signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID&amp;signal.demographics.age=25_to_29,30_to_34&amp;signal.demographics.gender=female'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p><strong>Key response fields to retain from <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">results.heatmap[]</span></code>:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">location.latitude</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">location.longitude</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">location.geohash</span></code> — the geographic cell</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.affinity</span></code> — relative interest at this location (0–1)</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.affinity_rank</span></code> — how this cell ranks vs. others in the set (0–1); use this to find hotspots</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.popularity</span></code> — overall signal density at this location</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>LLM use:</strong> Sort cells by <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">affinity_rank</span></code> descending. The top cells represent the highest-concentration targeting zones. The LLM can translate geohash clusters into neighborhood-level descriptions.</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-7-audience-segment-comparison"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 7: Audience Segment Comparison</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 7: Audience Segment Comparison" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-7-audience-segment-comparison"></a></h2>
<p>Use <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/analysis/compare</span></code><sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/analysis-compare-1">8</a></sup> to identify the shared taste space between your brand and a competitor, or between two audience segments. This helps identify what both share (safe positioning) and where they diverge (differentiation opportunity).</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/analysis/compare?a.signal.interests.entities=BRAND_ENTITY_ID&amp;b.signal.interests.entities=COMPETITOR_ENTITY_ID&amp;take=15'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p><strong>Key response fields to retain from <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">results.tags[]</span></code>:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">tag_id</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">name</span></code> — the shared taste attribute</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.score</span></code> — strength of shared association (higher = stronger overlap)</li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">popularity</span></code> — how broadly this tag is present</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>LLM use:</strong> Tags with high <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">score</span></code> = shared audience messaging territory. Tags unique to your brand's taste profile (from Step 2 but absent here) = differentiation angles.</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>

<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="llm-prompt-template"></div><div class="heading-text">LLM Prompt Template</div><a aria-label="Skip link to LLM Prompt Template" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#llm-prompt-template"></a></h3>
<pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">You are a marketing strategist. Below is structured audience intelligence 
from Qloo's cultural AI. Analyze it and produce:

1. PRIMARY AUDIENCE: The segment with the strongest evidence (highest 
   affinity scores across taste, demographics, and geography). 
   Recommend targeting approach and 2-3 message angles grounded in 
   the psychographic tags.

2. GEOGRAPHIC TARGETING: Based on heatmap hotspots, name the top 
   zones to activate (translate geohash clusters into city/neighborhood 
   language where possible). Suggest channel format suited to each zone.

3. UNEXPECTED SEGMENT: Identify any audience, cross-domain affinity, 
   or geographic hotspot that is surprising given the brand's category. 
   Explain why it's worth testing.

4. COMPETITIVE DIFFERENTIATION: Using the competitor overlap tags, 
   identify what messaging territory is shared (avoid) vs. what the 
   brand owns uniquely (lean in).

5. EVIDENCE RANKING: Rank all segments by confidence, citing which 
   Qloo signals (affinity score, demographic skew, geographic 
   concentration) support each rank.

Qloo data:
{{ INSERT ASSEMBLED JSON }}</span></code></pre>

<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="signal--llm-output-mapping"></div><div class="heading-text">Signal → LLM Output Mapping</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Signal → LLM Output Mapping" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#signal--llm-output-mapping"></a></h3>





































<div class="rdmd-table"><div class="rdmd-table-inner"><table><thead><tr><th>Qloo signal</th><th>LLM output it enables</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.affinity</span></code> (taste/tag)</td><td>Psychographic messaging themes</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.age.*</span></code> (demographics)</td><td>Age-targeted creative direction</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.gender.*</span></code></td><td>Gender-skewed channel/format decisions</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.affinity_rank</span></code> (heatmap)</td><td>Geo-targeted media buy locations</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.score</span></code> (compare)</td><td>Competitive positioning &amp; differentiation</td></tr><tr><td>Cross-domain <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">results.entities[]</span></code></td><td>Media channel selection (e.g., if top affinity = hip-hop artists → Spotify/YouTube)</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">popularity</span></code></td><td>Segment size proxy — higher popularity = broader reach potential</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div>

<p>The audience-related endpoints used in the workflow are all <strong>current, documented, and supported</strong>:</p>

























<div class="rdmd-table"><div class="rdmd-table-inner"><table><thead><tr><th>Endpoint used</th><th>Status</th><th>Purpose</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/audiences</span></code></td><td>✅ Current</td><td>Look up valid audience URNs by keyword</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/audience-types</span></code></td><td>✅ Current</td><td>List all audience category URNs</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">signal.demographics.audiences</span></code></td><td>✅ Current</td><td>Pass audience URNs as signals to <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/insights</span></code></td></tr></tbody></table></div></div>
<p>These are listed as active Lookup APIs in the API Overview<sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-overview#supporting-apis">2</a></sup>. The correct replacement for the deprecated endpoints is <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/insights</span></code> — which is exactly what the workflow uses for all recommendations, demographics, heatmaps, and taste analysis.</p>
<p>So the workflow is fully aligned with Qloo's current API. <h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="-dont-use-deprecated"></div><div class="heading-text">❌ Don't use (deprecated)</div><a aria-label="Skip link to ❌ Don't use (deprecated)" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#-dont-use-deprecated"></a></h3>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">GET /v2/audiences/types</div></code></pre></div></div>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="-what-to-do-instead"></div><div class="heading-text">✅ What to do instead</div><a aria-label="Skip link to ✅ What to do instead" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#-what-to-do-instead"></a></h3>
<p>Rather than enumerating audience types, <strong>search directly for audiences by keyword</strong> using <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/audiences</span></code> with <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">filter.query</span></code>:</p>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/audiences?filter.query=fitness&amp;take=10'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p>For the marketing workflow, you can run multiple keyword searches aligned to your product's space (e.g., "sneakers", "streetwear", "sustainability") to discover valid audience URNs — and the response already includes the <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">type</span></code> (parent category) on each result, so you don't need the types endpoint separately.</p>
<p>You can also reference the known valid audience parent URNs directly from the Hackathon Developer Guide<sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/qloo-llm-hackathon-developer-guide">1</a></sup> without needing to call any endpoint:</p>
<ul>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:hobbies_and_interests</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:spending_habits</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:lifestyle_preferences_beliefs</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:life_stage</span></code></li>
<li><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">urn:audience:communities</span></code></li>

</ul>

<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="what-id-recommend"></div><div class="heading-text">What I'd recommend</div><a aria-label="Skip link to What I'd recommend" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#what-id-recommend"></a></h3>
<p>Rather than relying on deprecated endpoints to discover audience URNs, <strong>hardcode the known URN taxonomy above</strong> and pass them directly into <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">signal.demographics.audiences</span></code> in your Insights calls.</p>

<h1 class="heading heading-1 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="qloo-audience-discovery-workflow"></div><div class="heading-text">Qloo Audience Discovery Workflow</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Qloo Audience Discovery Workflow" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#qloo-audience-discovery-workflow"></a></h1>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="use-case-handmade-beaded-bags--nigeria"></div><div class="heading-text">Use Case: Handmade Beaded Bags — Nigeria</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Use Case: Handmade Beaded Bags — Nigeria" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#use-case-handmade-beaded-bags--nigeria"></a></h2>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="pipeline-overview"></div><div class="heading-text">Pipeline Overview</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Pipeline Overview" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#pipeline-overview"></a></h2>
<pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">[Step 1] /search          → Resolve brand/competitor entity IDs + tags
         /v2/tags         → Find relevant category tag URNs
         /v2/tags/types   → Discover available tag namespaces
      ↓
[Step 2] /v2/insights (filter.type=urn:tag)
                          → Psychographic taste profile of this space
      ↓
[Step 3] /v2/insights (filter.type=urn:entity:brand)
         + signal.location.query=Nigeria
                          → What brands does this audience love locally?
      ↓
[Step 4] /v2/insights (filter.type=urn:demographics)
                          → Age &amp; gender breakdown
      ↓
[Step 5] /v2/insights (filter.type=urn:heatmap)
                          → Geographic concentration within Nigeria
      ↓
[Step 6] /v2/insights (filter.type=urn:entity:*)
         + signal.demographics.audiences (known URNs)
                          → Cross-domain affinities per audience segment
      ↓
[Step 7] /v2/analysis/compare
                          → Compare two audience segments or brands
      ↓
[Step 8] LLM Synthesis</span></code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-1a-resolve-category-tags-via-v2tags"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 1A: Resolve Category Tags via <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/tags</span></code></div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 1A: Resolve Category Tags via ,[object Object]" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-1a-resolve-category-tags-via-v2tags"></a></h2>
<p>Since handmade beaded bags are a niche product with no direct Qloo brand entity, start by finding relevant <strong>tag URNs</strong> that represent the product's space. These become your primary signals throughout the workflow.</p>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="request"></div><div class="heading-text">Request</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Request" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#request"></a></h3>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/v2/tags?filter.query=handmade&amp;take=10'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>























<div class="rdmd-table"><div class="rdmd-table-inner"><table><thead><tr><th>Parameter</th><th>Value</th><th>Purpose</th><th>Impact on Response</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">filter.query</span></code></td><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">handmade</span></code></td><td>Keyword search across tag names</td><td>Returns tags whose names match or are semantically close to the keyword</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">take</span></code></td><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">10</span></code></td><td>Max results to return (default 20, max 50)</td><td>Controls how many tags are returned</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div>
<p>Run multiple searches: <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">handmade</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">fashion accessories</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">artisan</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">beaded</span></code>, <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">luxury bags</span></code>.</p>

<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-1b-discover-tag-namespaces-via-v2tagstypes"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 1B: Discover Tag Namespaces via <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/v2/tags/types</span></code></div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 1B: Discover Tag Namespaces via ,[object Object]" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-1b-discover-tag-namespaces-via-v2tagstypes"></a></h2>
<p>Use the Get Tag Types endpoint<sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/get-tag-types">1</a></sup> to understand what tag categories exist for brands, so you know which namespaces to query in taste analysis.</p>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="request-1"></div><div class="heading-text">Request</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Request" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#request-1"></a></h3>

<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-1c-search-for-comparablecompetitor-brands-via-search"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 1C: Search for Comparable/Competitor Brands via <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/search</span></code></div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 1C: Search for Comparable/Competitor Brands via ,[object Object]" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-1c-search-for-comparablecompetitor-brands-via-search"></a></h2>
<p>Find Qloo entity IDs for analogous brands (e.g., African fashion brands, artisan accessories brands) to use as signals. These act as proxies for your product's audience.</p>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="request-2"></div><div class="heading-text">Request</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Request" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#request-2"></a></h3>
<div class="CodeTabs CodeTabs_initial theme-light"><div class="CodeTabs-toolbar"><button type="button" value="bash">Bash</button></div><div class="CodeTabs-inner"><pre><code class="rdmd-code lang-shell theme-light" data-lang="shell"><div class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><span class="cm-builtin">curl</span> <span class="cm-attribute">--request</span> GET \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--url</span> <span class="cm-string">'https://api.qloo.com/search?query=Ankara+fashion&amp;types=urn:entity:brand&amp;take=5'</span> \
  <span class="cm-attribute">--header</span> <span class="cm-string">'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY'</span></div></code></pre></div></div>
<p><strong>Parameters:</strong></p>

<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-2-taste-analysis--psychographic-profile"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 2: Taste Analysis — Psychographic Profile</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 2: Taste Analysis — Psychographic Profile" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-2-taste-analysis--psychographic-profile"></a></h2>
<p>Use Taste Analysis<sup><a target="_self" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/taste-analysis">2</a></sup> with <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">filter.type=urn:tag</span></code> to discover the psychographic vocabulary that defines this product's audience. Combine the tag signals from Step 1 with location scoping for Nigeria.</p>
<h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="request-3"></div><div class="heading-text">Request</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Request" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#request-3"></a></h3>

<div class="rdmd-table"><div class="rdmd-table-inner"><table><thead><tr><th>Field</th><th>Usage</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">entity_id</span></code></td><td>Use as signal in Step 6 for audience-layered queries</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">name</span></code></td><td>Pass to LLM — correlated brands indicate media adjacency and partnership potential</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">query.affinity</span></code></td><td>Correlation strength; sort descending — top results are strongest cultural co-occurrences</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">popularity</span></code></td><td>High popularity = broad reach; low popularity = niche/emerging segment</td></tr><tr><td><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">tags[]</span></code></td><td>Reveals shared taste attributes between your product and the correlated entity</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>LLM use:</strong> Correlated artists tell the LLM which music/cultural figures to reference in creative. Correlated TV shows indicate where to buy media. Correlated brands identify retail partners or competitive context.</p>
</blockquote>

<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-4-demographic-breakdown"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 4: Demographic Breakdown</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 4: Demographic Breakdown" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-4-demographic-breakdown"></a></h2>
<p>Use <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">filter.type=urn:demographics</span></code> to understand the age and gender skew of the beaded bags audience in Nigeria.</p>

The LLM should flag <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">25_to_29: 0.61</span></code> as a strong secondary cohort and <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">55_and_older: -0.41</span></code> as not worth targeting.</p>
</blockquote>

</blockquote>

<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="step-6-audience-segment-layering"></div><div class="heading-text">Step 6: Audience Segment Layering</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Step 6: Audience Segment Layering" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="https://docs.qloo.com/reference/api-onboarding#step-6-audience-segment-layering"></a></h2>
<p>Use the known audience URN taxonomy directly — no deprecated endpoint needed. Pass audience URNs as <code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">signal.demographics.audiences</span></code> to produce audience-conditioned insights.</p>
